_doc: Group and class of every Omni listing seen in a stored snapshot. Rules and the build-time fallback for listings not yet in this file are in pipeline/market/classify.py. `basis` records how each entry was decided: swap (contract type), major (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE), funding_floor (annualised funding printed the crypto floor 0.1095), funding_zero (printed exactly 0: TradFi perpetual), pre_ipo_rate (printed the fixed 0.05475), name (decided from the asset name because no marker rate has printed). Classes follow Variational's own terms: crypto, equity, etf, index, commodity, fx, pre_ipo. The class of a TradFi listing is assigned from its name (pre_ipo from its fixed funding rate). `listed` dates each listing by its earliest evidence (see pipeline/market/listings.py). Extend with: /usr/bin/python3 pipeline/build_market.py --classify, then review the added lines.

notes.name_basis: LTC-PERP, SUI-PERP and TRX-PERP funded below the floor in every stored snapshot, so no marker rate printed; Litecoin, Sui and TRON are crypto assets.
notes.tokenised_gold: PAXG-PERP and XAUT-PERP are crypto (tokens, funding at the crypto floor).
notes.etf_on_crypto: ZCSH-PERP (Grayscale Zcash ETF) is a listed fund with a 0% interest rate: tradfi_perp, etf.
notes.us500_perp: US500-PERP is named after the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust and the docs give its underlying as 'an ETF composed of a basket of the leading 500 US stocks': etf. US500-SWAP references CME E-mini S&P 500 futures: index.
notes.dollar_and_volatility: DXI-SWAP (ICE U.S. Dollar Index futures) and VXI-SWAP (Cboe VIX futures) are index, following Variational's docs ('equity, volatility, and dollar indices'). No FX listing exists yet.
notes.pre_ipo: OPENAI-PERP and ANTHROPIC-PERP (last seen 11 Nov 2026) fund at the fixed pre-IPO rate: pre_ipo. ANT-PERP (Anthropic PBC, first seen 20 Nov 2026) and QNTX-PERP (Quantinuum Inc. Class A Common Stock, called pre-IPO in the 12 Jun 2026 update) now fund as regular TradFi perpetuals: equity.
notes.swap_financing: roll: weekday whose payment covers the weekend (fri for indices and commodities, wed for FX and precious metals; docs, Swaps Funding). benchmark: true where financing is a benchmark rate plus a spread (equity indices on SOFR, precious metals), false where it is futures-curve carry (other commodities, VXI, DXI). See pipeline/market/financing.py.
notes.equity_or_etf: A fund, trust or leveraged product is etf; a company share is equity, including ADRs (ARM, TSM, BABA, NVO, NOK, SONY, ASML) and Strategy's preferred share STRC-PERP. Named as funds without the word ETF: QQQ-PERP (Invesco QQQ Trust), SQQQ-PERP and TBT-PERP (ProShares), all etf. SPCX-PERP carries the name 'SPAC and New Issue ETF': etf by name, although Variational's May and June 2026 updates list a 'SpaceX' market and no other ticker fits it.
